# Alexander Blackwood

> GTM engineer and revenue operations architect based in Delray Beach, Florida. 14+ years building the CRM, integration, automation, and AI systems that go-to-market teams run on — HubSpot, Salesforce, NetSuite, n8n, PostgreSQL, and Claude/MCP agents. Works as a solo senior engineer: the person you talk to is the person who builds it. Month-to-month, no lock-in.

Alexander sits at the intersection of business process, data systems, and AI. The work follows three pillars: redesign workflows around AI and automation, build the systems that execute them, then operate those systems in production ("Workflow Redesign → System Construction → Command & Control").

Service lines: AI solutions (LLM features and MCP-connected agents), data integration (HubSpot ↔ NetSuite, Salesforce ↔ marketing automation), workflow automation, custom internal software, data architecture, and fractional CTO engagements.

Contact: alexander@alexblackwood.xyz · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/rebel-spirit
